description: Feature schema for XGBoost application risk scoring model

features.name: document_completeness
features.description: Ratio of required documents present vs required

features.name: required_field_completeness
features.description: Ratio of required fields populated in normalized profile

features.name: eligibility_pass_ratio
features.description: Ratio of scheme eligibility rules passed

features.name: budget_consistency
features.description: 1.0 if no budget contradiction detected, 0.0 otherwise

features.name: certificate_validity
features.description: 1.0 if certificate authenticity check passed, 0.0 if warning

features.name: suspicious_indicator_count
features.description: Count of suspicious indicators (low confidence, high cost, etc.)

features.name: document_quality
features.description: Overall document quality ratio from validation checks

features.name: proposal_quality
features.description: Average of field completeness and extraction confidence

features.name: project_feasibility
features.description: Average of rule pass ratio and contradiction absence

features.name: environmental_impact
features.description: 0.7 if environmental benefit text present, 0.4 otherwise

features.name: extraction_confidence
features.description: Average extraction confidence from normalization service

label.name: risk_class
label.description: 1 if application was ultimately rejected/flagged as high-risk, 0 otherwise
